alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:4e507a15-c.title: Manager, Strategic Sales
alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:4e507a15-c.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE We are seeking a Sales Manager to help lead a team of Strategic Account Executives. This person will be responsible for building and coaching a team of high-performing sales reps, driving revenue growth, and partnering closely with product and engineering to bring our cutting-edge AI infrastructure to customers. RESPONSIBILITIES - Lead and mentor a team of Strategic Account Executives to consistently exceed pipeline and revenue goals. - Help define and execution on go-to-market strategy for our fastest growing customer segment. - Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and Engineering to align customer needs with Baseten’s product roadmap. - Be deeply engaged with the product, enabling reps to have highly technical conversations with prospects and customers. - Foster a culture of accountability, learning, and collaboration within the sales team. REQUIREMENTS - 6+ years of closing sales experience, with 2+ years in management leading high-performing teams. - Strong technical acumen, ideally with background in AI infrastructure, cloud infrastructure, or developer platforms. - Comfortable operating in the weeds with technical products and guiding reps through complex deals. - Proven track record of success in Strategic/Enterprise sales environments. - Based in San Francisco or New York and open to coming in office at least 3 days per week (Tuesday-Thursday). BENEFITS - Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity. - 100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision insurance for employee and dependents - Flexible PTO policy including company wide Winter Break (our offices are closed from Christmas Eve to New Year's Day!) - Paid parental leave - Fertility and family-building stipend through Carrot - Company-facilitated 401(k) - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities. Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you. At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable law (by example, the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, where applicable).

axiomtalentplatform-axiomtalentplatform:.description: We are currently seeking Investigations Lawyers to work with Axiom clients across a range of industries, supporting a broad range of corporate, employee, compliance, regulatory and misconduct investigations. Responsibilities: Conduct or support legally privileged investigations into matters including employee misconduct, whistleblowing, fraud, regulatory concerns, compliance breaches and other sensitive issues. Define investigation scope, review documentation, develop investigation plans, conduct interviews and manage evidence-gathering processes. Prepare clear investigation reports, summaries and recommendations, and advise on appropriate remedial actions and risk-mitigation measures. Work closely with HR, compliance, risk, senior management and external advisers to manage sensitive matters and deliver practical, business-focused advice. Minimum Qualifications: Qualified lawyer eligible to practise in the UK, with relevant investigations experience gained in-house, in private practice or within a regulatory, compliance or advisory environment. Experience supporting or leading investigations involving corporate, employee, conduct, regulatory, fraud, whistleblowing or compliance matters. Strong analytical, interviewing, drafting and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to handle sensitive and confidential matters appropriately. Qualified lawyer in the UK or an equivalent jurisdiction, or experienced investigations professional with strong corporate, employee, regulatory, compliance or fraud investigations experience. Compensation, Benefits & Location: This role offers a highly competitive compensation and benefits package in the alternative legal services marketplace, that includes health benefits, pension and more. Axiomites also get access to professional development resources and learning and development programs. Axiom provides the opportunity to work remotely, onsite or hybrid, depending on client requirements. Axiom is the global leader in high-calibre, on-demand legal talent. Covering North America, the UK, Europe, and APAC, we enable legal departments to drive efficiency and growth and meet the demands of today’s business landscape with best in breed alterative legal services. Axiom is a leader in diversity, inclusion, and social engagement. Diversity is core to our values and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be named a best place to work for LGBTQ+ Equality, earning top marks in the 2021 Corporate Equality Index for the second consecutive year. Axiom’s legal department is Mansfield certified and is committed to considering at least 50% diverse candidates for leadership roles and outside counsel representation. Learn more about working at Axiom . Equal Opportunity Employer: Axiom ensures equal employment opportunity in recruitment and employment, without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, nationality, national or ethnic origin, religious creed or belief, political opinion, sex, gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, age, disability, alienage or citizenship status, marital (or civil or other partnership recognized by law) status, genetic predisposition or carrier status, sexual orientation, military service, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Axiom prohibits and will not tolerate any such discrimination or harassment. We understand that many legal professionals have chosen to adopt the consultancy model, and we are happy to discuss this option with you. We offer both consultants and employees the opportunity to work with our enviable client roster. Contact us in complete confidence to find out more about opportunities to work with Axiom as an employee or consultant. Accommodation for Individuals with Disabilities: Upon request and consistent with applicable laws, Axiom will provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities who require an accommodation to participate in each stage of the recruitment process. distro-distro:lever:589b81c3-10bb-4b13-8.description: About Us Vensure Employer Solutions is the largest privately held organization in the HR technology and service sector, providing a comprehensive portfolio of solutions, including HR/HCM technology, managed services, and global business process outsourcing (BPO). The company and its service providers collectively serve over 95,000 businesses and process over $135B in annual payroll. As a "One Employer Solution” headquartered in Chandler, Arizona, Vensure helps thousands of businesses streamline and grow their operations with custom strategies that benefit both employers and employees. Find out more by visiting www.vensure.com . Position Summary The Channel Partner Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and executing strategic partner marketing programs that drive partner engagement, demand generation, pipeline growth, and revenue performance. This role collaborates closely with crossfunctional teams and external partners to create and implement co-marketing initiatives, partner enablement resources, and go-to-market campaigns that support business objectives. The position leverages data, market insights, and partner feedback to optimize program effectiveness, strengthen partner relationships, and expand the organization's channel marketing impact. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Develop and execute comprehensive channel partner marketing strategies that drive partner recruitment, onboarding, enablement, engagement, retention, and joint demand generation to support revenue growth and market expansion. Design, create, and manage integrated co-marketing initiatives, including co-branded campaigns, partner toolkits, sales enablement resources, newsletters, presentations, digital assets, and partner communications that strengthen partner effectiveness and brand alignment. Partner cross-functionally with Partnerships, Sales, Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Marketing Operations, Creative, and Web teams to ensure partner marketing programs align with strategic business objectives, go-to-market initiatives, and revenue targets. Collaborate with partner relationship and account management teams to assess partner needs, identify growth opportunities, and develop marketing programs that increase partner adoption, engagement, and solution promotion efforts. Plan and support partner launches, marketplace initiatives, webinars, product campaigns, sales plays, and partner-led marketing activities that increase market visibility, lead generation, and pipeline contribution. Develop and maintain scalable onboarding, training, certification, and go-to-market resources that enable partners to effectively understand solution positioning, messaging, value propositions, and available marketing programs. Ensure all partner-facing marketing materials, communications, and campaign assets remain accurate, compliant, brand-consistent, and aligned with approved corporate messaging and product positioning. Lead the execution of partner marketing projects by managing intake processes, timelines, deliverables, stakeholder communications, approvals, and asset maintenance across multiple concurrent initiatives. Monitor, analyze, and report on key performance indicators related to partner campaigns, co-marketing programs, partner engagement, lead generation, pipeline influence, and return on marketing investment. Leverage campaign analytics, partner feedback, market insights, and performance data to continuously optimize marketing effectiveness, improve partner engagement, and identify opportunities to scale and enhance channel marketing programs. Establish and maintain strong relationships with strategic partners and internal stakeholders to foster collaboration, maximize program adoption, and achieve shared business objectives. getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:e21ef574-32f.title: Sales Development Representative
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:e21ef574-32f.description: Wing Assistant is building the next generation of AI-enabled workforce solutions for growing businesses, and our growth depends on a steady flow of qualified sales opportunities. We're hiring a Sales Development Representative to be the tip of that spear: the first person prospective customers meet and the engine that keeps our pipeline full. This is a high-energy, high-ownership seat for someone early in their sales career who wants to learn the craft fast and grow into bigger things. You'll identify companies that are actively hiring for roles Wing can support, reach out with a compelling alternative to traditional hiring, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives. It's a great fit for someone who's competitive, well-organized, motivated by clear targets, and genuinely curious about how AI, remote talent, and global workforce solutions are changing the way companies build teams. Generate and Qualify Pipeline Identify companies actively hiring for roles Wing can service, such as Executive Assistants, Admin Assistants, Customer Support, Sales Support, Recruiting Support, Operations Support, and other business support roles. Research target accounts to understand what they are hiring for, why they may need support, and where Wing could be a strong fit. Reach out to prospective customers across email, phone, LinkedIn, and other outbound channels. Run focused outbound campaigns around hiring signals, job postings, company growth, and operational pain points. Hold early discovery conversations to understand the prospect's hiring needs, pain points, urgency, and openness to remote talent or AI-enabled workforce solutions. Communicate what Wing Assistant does and why it matters clearly enough to earn the next meeting. Book qualified appointments for Account Executives with companies that have a clear need, relevant hiring activity, or a strong use case for Wing. Partner with the Sales Team Work hand-in-hand with Account Executives to build and protect a healthy, well-qualified pipeline. Hand off opportunities cleanly, with the context AEs need to move deals forward. Share key details from discovery calls, including the role the company is hiring for, current hiring process, pain points, timing, budget signals, and decision-makers involved. Keep activity, notes, and pipeline data accurate and current in our CRM. Bring the Market Back In Feed what you're hearing from prospects back to the Sales, Marketing, and Product teams. Help refine messaging and outreach based on what's actually landing with companies. Identify patterns in hiring demand, objections, and industries where Wing is resonating. Suggest new outbound angles based on job postings, hiring trends, and prospect conversations. Core Requirements 1–4+ years in sales, business development, appointment setting, cold calling, recruiting, staffing, or a comparable outbound role. A real interest in B2B sales; bonus points if it's in SaaS, AI, staffing, recruiting, outsourcing, or global workforce operations. Proven background in sales prospecting, cold calling, appointment setting, or high-volume outbound outreach. Strong written and verbal communication; you can get to the point and make it compelling. Comfort reaching out to companies that may not have considered remote assistants, virtual assistants, or offshore talent before. Strong research skills and the ability to turn hiring signals into relevant outbound messaging. Strong organization and the resilience to keep going when a day doesn't go your way. The drive that comes from chasing clear goals, activity metrics, and booked meeting targets. The ability to run your own desk while still collaborating well across teams. A genuine eagerness to learn the product, the industry, and the sales craft quickly. Nice to Have Exposure to staffing companies, recruiting firms, BPOs, outsourcing companies, virtual assistant companies, digital agent companies, or high-ticket professional services organizations. ghj-ghj:lever:69e3cb6d-8002-46d7-bf19-2d.title: Assistant Controller
ghj-ghj:lever:69e3cb6d-8002-46d7-bf19-2d.description: GHJ Search and Staffing serves as the recruitment division of GHJ, a prominent national accounting and advisory firm. Our team provides qualified Accounting and Finance professionals on a temporary and permanent basis across a broad range of industries. GHJ’s relationship with our Global Advisory and Accounting Network provides the resources needed to better understand client’s needs, attract a higher caliber of candidates and assess candidate potential. Job Summary The Assistant Controller is a hands-on leader responsible for overseeing daily Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable operations while supporting core accounting functions, financial reporting, and month-end close. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, enjoys building strong cross-functional relationships, and takes pride in delivering accurate, timely financial work. You’ll guide and develop a team across multiple locations, help standardize processes through an ERP transformation, and serve as a key partner to the Controller and leadership team. This role will be onsite in Dyersburg, TN. Relocation Assistance is available. Responsibilities Responsibilities Oversee day-to-day Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable operations across all manufacturing locations. Manage customer invoicing, collections, cash application, and resolution of billing issues with Sales and Customer Service. Monitor AR aging, follow up on overdue accounts, and ensure accurate revenue recognition. Lead vendor invoice processing, payment runs, and expense reimbursements while maintaining positive vendor relationships. Ensure compliance with purchasing policies, approval workflows, internal controls, and audit readiness. Support 1099 reporting and year-end AP close procedures. Lead and develop AR/AP specialists, providing coaching, training, and performance feedback. Assist with month-end close, journal entries, reconciliations, and preparation of financial statements. Participate in budgeting, forecasting, audit preparation, and ongoing financial analyses. Collaborate with the Controller on internal controls, policy improvements, and special projects. Qualifications Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable, including at least 2 years in a supervisory role. Strong understanding of GAAP, internal controls, and foundational accounting principles. Experience in high-volume AP/AR environments; manufacturing or multi-site experience preferred. Proficiency with ERP systems (Infor LN a plus) and strong Excel skills. Clear, confident communication with the ability to partner effectively across departments. A calm, organized, proactive approach to managing deadlines and solving problems. Ability to lead through change, especially in centralizing or modernizing AP/AR processes.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:0f2b0d7a-a591-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Engineering Manager, AI Product Development based in Mexico. This is a hands-on engineering leadership role focused on building and scaling AI-enabled products and modern software platforms. You’ll lead a team of senior engineers while remaining deeply involved in architecture, technical decisions, and complex implementation challenges. The role combines people leadership, product partnership, and technical execution in a remote-first, globally distributed environment. You’ll help drive the adoption of AI-assisted and agentic development practices to improve productivity, quality, testing, and delivery speed. Working across frontend, backend, data, cloud, and AI systems, you’ll shape scalable solutions while balancing performance, maintainability, cost, and speed. You’ll also influence engineering culture, delivery practices, reliability, security, and modernization initiatives. This opportunity is well suited to an experienced engineering leader who enjoys developing people while staying close to technology and innovation. Lead and mentor a team of senior software engineers, fostering ownership, accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement. Partner with Product, Design, Operations, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and high-impact product outcomes. Influence product direction by challenging assumptions, advocating for user-focused decisions, and helping teams prioritize meaningful outcomes. Design, review, and evolve scalable architectures while breaking complex initiatives into actionable technical plans. Drive the adoption of AI-assisted and agentic development workflows to improve engineering productivity, code quality, testing, and delivery. Guide development of modern full-stack applications using technologies such as TypeScript, React, Next.js, shadcn/ui, Supabase/Postgres, APIs, and cloud services. Provide technical leadership across frontend, backend, data, distributed systems, and AI-enabled capabilities. Lead code reviews, architecture reviews, and technical design discussions while maintaining strong engineering standards. Improve CI/CD, testing, observability, reliability, security, and operational practices across the engineering organization. Monitor engineering metrics and delivery indicators to identify risks, improve predictability, and support data-driven decision-making. Lead modernization initiatives, technical debt reduction, automation, and broader platform evolution efforts. Remain hands-on when needed, contributing to architecture, implementation, debugging, technical investigations, and proof-of-concept development. Promote effective asynchronous communication and collaboration across globally distributed teams. Requirements 8+ years of professional software engineering experience building and supporting production systems. Previous experience leading engineering teams, mentoring developers, and taking accountability for technical delivery. Hands-on experience integrating AI capabilities such as LLMs, AI agents, RAG systems, or AI-powered workflows into products or engineering processes. Strong experience with modern web development using TypeScript, React, and Next.js. Proven ability to design scalable APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications. Strong knowledge of relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL or MySQL. Experience with CI/CD automation, testing strategies, monitoring, observability, and production operations. Demonstrated ability to balance technical leadership with hands-on execution and delivery accountability. Experience modernizing systems and improving engineering effectiveness through automation, tooling, and process improvements. jobgether-jobgether:lever:1778b4ba-cab0-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Technical Consultant based in United States. This is a senior consulting opportunity focused on delivering sophisticated Atlassian-based technology solutions for customers across diverse industries. You will combine technical expertise, solution design, and project leadership to translate business requirements into scalable implementations. The role spans technical discovery, architecture, configuration, integrations, migrations, troubleshooting, and end-to-end technical delivery. You will work closely with solutions and project teams while also providing technical guidance and informal mentorship to other consultants. Your expertise will help customers modernize collaboration, IT service management, Agile delivery, and work management environments. The position offers exposure to complex Atlassian ecosystems, cloud transformations, customizations, and enterprise technology challenges. It is well suited to a technically strong consultant who can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership of complex delivery engagements. Lead and guide consulting teams in implementing technical solutions aligned with customer requirements and established solution strategies. Conduct technical discovery sessions to understand customer environments, configurations, existing challenges, system capabilities, and improvement opportunities. Define and document technical architectures, implementation approaches, technical designs, and solution presentations. Serve as the primary technical point of contact for designing and implementing customer solutions throughout project delivery. Decompose technical work into actionable tasks, assign activities where appropriate, and coordinate execution across project teams. Design, configure, deploy, and integrate Atlassian applications according to customer requirements and technical specifications. Build integrations and customizations based on solution designs and functional specifications. Analyze customer technical needs and translate them into practical, scalable, and maintainable solutions. Develop technical and functional specifications, requirements documentation, architecture diagrams, and delivery materials. Install and configure Jira and Confluence Server environments on Linux platforms when required. Create and implement cloud environments according to customer specifications and technical requirements. Lead Server/Data Center-to-Cloud migrations for Atlassian applications. Implement basic to complex Jira and related application workflows. Develop or support specific add-ons and custom technical components as required. Resolve complex technical issues and provide recommendations to improve system performance, feasibility, reliability, and maintainability. Provide technical advice and recommendations throughout projects, ensuring solutions align with customer objectives and technical best practices. Take ownership of technical delivery across assigned projects while collaborating closely with project and solutions teams. Provide technical knowledge and informal mentorship to other technical consultants and contribute to the continuous improvement of delivery practices. Requirements: 3–6 years of proven experience in ITSM, Agile, digital transformation, or technology consulting. 3–6 years of strong hands-on experience with Atlassian products, particularly Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence, and Bitbucket; Jira Align experience is a plus. Demonstrated ability to connect technology capabilities with business objectives and measurable customer outcomes. Experience designing, configuring, implementing, and troubleshooting Atlassian environments. Experience with Atlassian application migrations, including Server/Data Center-to-Cloud transformations.
